text:
elena: kicking off precision rollout for ff:llm-context-adapt at 22:10 UTC. goal: improve context window reuse; risk is subtle content drop on long prompts. plan: micro(3%) -> team-canary(12%) -> staged-1(35%) -> staged-2(80%). step_interval=6m, soak=3m. runtime pinned to v2.8.0 for the window.
gopal: ack. what exact guardrails should we watch?
elena: guardrails: p90 latency increase > 50ms for 2 consecutive soaks => pause. customer error-rate > 0.4% OR OOM => immediate rollback. quality: DRIFT_SCORE > 1.3x baseline -> pause and sample.
ria: enabling token-diff sampling and keeping a small audit stream to #model-audit for 15m. I'll also turn on expanded traces for the first 8m.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: ff:llm-context-adapt -> cohorts: micro(3%), team-canary(12%), staged-1(35%), staged-2(80%). start=1789992345 step=6m soak=3m pinned_version=v2.8.0. runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/rls-820
cs-bot: release-note tag added: rollout/context-adapt. Support channel #support-watch notified.
gopal: paste a one-liner for triage pls.
elena: release notes: "llm-context-adapt: smarter context reuse to reduce re-tokenization; staged rollout pinned to runtime v2.8.0. Watch p90 latency, DRIFT_SCORE, and OOMs."
ria: rollback/yank commands if we need to stop quickly:
```
# immediate kill switch
/feature toggle ff:llm-context-adapt off --force
# shrink a cohort to zero
/feature set-cohort ff:llm-context-adapt staged-2 0
# graceful drain with annotation
/feature drain-cohort ff:llm-context-adapt team-canary --annotate "drain-for-analysis"
```
oncall-bot: monitors created -> monitor/p90-context-latency (threshold 50ms eval 4m) -> notify #eng-oncall + #eng-releases. monitor/ooms critical. monitor/drift-score (1.3x) -> notify ML + this channel.
elena: decision flow: one monitor fire -> pause further ramps and run a focused 20m analysis; second fire or any OOM -> full rollback and open rollback ticket tagged rollback/context-adapt. keep runtime pinned until ML signoff.
gopal: if we pause do we unpin? prefer to keep pinned to avoid mixed-kernel telemetry.
elena: keep pinned, yes. only unpin when we're confident and have post-rollout verification.
ria: starting micro in ~2m. I'll post 3m aggregates every soak. @deploy-bot please post cohort events here.
deploy-bot: micro cohort enabled (3%) at 1789992460. event: cohort->micro, pinned=v2.8.0.
ria: sampling 400 outputs -> DRIFT_SCORE baseline=0.45 current=0.47 (small jitter), p90 delta +9ms. no OOMs.
gopal: fine for now. keep an eye on session-based prompts; I'll watch customer error-rate.
oncall-bot: heartbeat: no alerts.
elena: moving to team-canary in 6m if no guardrails. quick note: if a cohort shows isolated regression we may zero that cohort and continue elsewhere (cohort-scoped rollback). fallback routing: route to runtime v2.7.x variant if capacity or regressions persist.
ria: I'll tag any flagged examples with #context-adapt-anom and upload to runbook ticket.
cs-bot: reminder: change window ends at 00:30 UTC. if we stop mid-rollout, open rollback ticket and notify relevant CSMs.
elena: thanks team, updates brief at each cohort step. :eyes:
